## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle revised recension of the **Sìfēn *bhikṣu-prātimokṣa*** edited by **Dàoxuān** 道宣 ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) for the practical use of the Nánshān Vinaya school. 刪定 *shān-dìng* "edited and fixed" indicates the editorial method: Dàoxuān reviewed the existing transmission of the Dharmaguptaka *prātimokṣa* ([KR6k0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0010), [KR6k0011](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0011)) and produced a new recension correcting transmissional errors and standardising the rule-formulations.

**Abstract**

The *Xīn shāndìng* recension is a key witness to Dàoxuān's project of constructing a **standardised, authoritative *prātimokṣa* edition** for the canonical *Sìfēn* Vinaya tradition in early-Tang China. The work supplemented the older Buddhayaśas-period *prātimokṣa* extracts ([KR6k0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0010), [KR6k0011](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0011)) and provided the basis for Dàoxuān's own *Sìfēn lǜ bǐqiū hánzhù jièběn* ([KR6k0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0131)) — the comprehensive *prātimokṣa*-with-commentary that became the universal *Sìfēn* recitation-text of East Asian Buddhism.
